name: GluetunVPN
description: # Gluetun VPN client Lightweight swiss-knife-like VPN client to multiple VPN service providers # Quick links - Setup - https://github.com/qdm12/gluetun-wiki - Problem? - Check the Wiki: https://github.com/qdm12/gluetun-wiki - Start a discussion: https://github.com/qdm12/gluetun/discussions - Fix the Unraid template: https://github.com/qdm12/gluetun/discussions/550 - Suggestion? - Create an issue: https://github.com/qdm12/gluetun/issues - Join the Slack channel: https://join.slack.com/t/qdm12/shared_invite/enQtOTE0NjcxNTM1ODc5LTYyZmVlOTM3MGI4ZWU0YmJkMjUxNmQ4ODQ2OTAwYzMxMTlhY2Q1MWQyOWUyNjc2ODliNjFjMDUxNWNmNzk5MDk - Happy? - Sponsor me: https://github.com/sponsors/qdm12 - Donate: https://www.paypal.me/qmcgaw - Drop me an email: quentin.mcgaw@gmail.com - Want to add a VPN provider? - Check development: https://github.com/qdm12/gluetun-wiki/blob/main/contributing/development.md - Add a provider: https://github.com/qdm12/gluetun-wiki/blob/main/contributing/add-a-provider.md # Features - Based on Alpine 3.18 for a small Docker image of 35.6MB - Supports: **AirVPN**, **Cyberghost**, **ExpressVPN**, **FastestVPN**, **Giganews**, **HideMyAss**, **IPVanish**, **IVPN**, **Mullvad**, **NordVPN**, **Perfect Privacy**, **Privado**, **Private Internet Access**, **PrivateVPN**, **ProtonVPN**, **PureVPN**, **SlickVPN**, **Surfshark**, **TorGuard**, **VPNSecure.me**, **VPNUnlimited**, **Vyprvpn**, **WeVPN**, **Windscribe** servers - Supports OpenVPN for all providers listed - Supports Wireguard both kernelspace and userspace - For **Mullvad**, **Ivpn**, **Surfshark** and **Windscribe** - For **ProtonVPN**, **PureVPN**, **Torguard**, **VPN Unlimited** and **WeVPN** using the custom provider - For custom Wireguard configurations using the custom provider - More in progress, see: https://github.com/qdm12/gluetun/issues/134 - DNS over TLS baked in with service provider(s) of your choice - DNS fine blocking of malicious/ads/surveillance hostnames and IP addresses, with live update every 24 hours - Choose the vpn network protocol, `udp` or `tcp` - Built in firewall kill switch to allow traffic only with needed the VPN servers and LAN devices - Built in Shadowsocks proxy (protocol based on SOCKS5 with an encryption layer, tunnels TCP+UDP) - Built in HTTP proxy (tunnels HTTP and HTTPS through TCP) - Connect other containers to it - Connect LAN devices to it - Compatible with amd64, i686 (32 bit), **ARM** 64 bit, ARM 32 bit v6 and v7, and even ppc64le 🎆 - Custom VPN server side port forwarding for Private Internet Access - Possibility of split horizon DNS by selecting multiple DNS over TLS providers - Unbound subprogram drops root privileges once launched - Can work as a Kubernetes sidecar container, thanks @rorph # Setup 🎉 There are now instructions specific to each VPN provider with examples to help you get started as quickly as possible! Go to the Wiki: https://github.com/qdm12/gluetun-wiki 🆕 Image also available as `ghcr.io/qdm12/gluetun` # License MIT: https://github.com/qdm12/gluetun/master/LICENSE

ports.name: HTTPPROXY_PORT
ports.description: Internal port number for the HTTP proxy to listen on

variables.name: TIMEZONE
variables.description: Specify a timezone to use to have correct log times. i.e. Europe/London

variables.name: VPN_SERVICE_PROVIDER
variables.description: VPN Service Provider

variables.name: VPN_TYPE
variables.description: VPN Type. Default is OpenVPN. Note not all providers support Wireguard.

variables.name: VPN_INTERFACE
variables.description: OPTIONAL: Specify a custom network interface name to use. (e.g. tun0 or wg0)

variables.name: VPN_ENDPOINT_PORT
variables.description: OPTIONAL: Custom OpenVPN/Wireguard server endpoint port to use

variables.name: VPN_ENDPOINT_IP
variables.description: OPTIONAL: Specify a target VPN IP address to use

variables.name: OPENVPN_PROTOCOL
variables.description: OPTIONAL: Container Variable: OPENVPN_PROTOCOL

variables.name: OPENVPN_USER
variables.description: Container Variable: OPENVPN_USER

variables.name: OPENVPN_PASSWORD
variables.description: Container Variable: OPENVPN_PASSWORD (Optional for Mullvad)

variables.name: OPENVPN_VERSION
variables.description: OPTIONAL: Set the OpenVPN version to run

variables.name: OPENVPN_VERBOSITY
variables.description: OPTIONAL: OpenVPN verbosity level

variables.name: OPENVPN_FLAGS
variables.description: OPTIONAL: Space delimited OpenVPN flags to pass to openvpn

variables.name: OPENVPN_CIPHERS
variables.description: OPTIONAL: Specify one or more custom ciphers to use

variables.name: OPENVPN_AUTH
variables.description: OPTIONAL: Specify a custom auth algorithm to use. i.e. sha256

variables.name: OPENVPN_PROCESS_USER
variables.description: OPTIONAL: Run OpenVPN as root

variables.name: OPENVPN_IPV6
variables.description: OPTIONAL: Enable tunneling of IPv6 (only for Mullvad)

variables.name: OPENVPN_CUSTOM_CONFIG
variables.description: OPTIONAL: The path to your OpenVPN configuration file. This implies VPN_SERVICE_PROVIDER=custom

variables.name: WIREGUARD_IMPLEMENTATION
variables.description: Implementation of Wireguard to use.

variables.name: WIREGUARD_PRIVATE_KEY
variables.description: OPTINAL: 32 bytes private key in base64 format

variables.name: WIREGUARD_PRESHARED_KEY
variables.description: OPTINAL: 32 bytes pre-shared key in base64 format

variables.name: WIREGUARD_PUBLIC_KEY
variables.description: Only for VPN_SERVICE_PROVIDER=custom and VPN_TYPE=wireguard: Wireguard server public key

variables.name: WIREGUARD_ADDRESSES
variables.description: Wireguard IP network in the format xx.xx.xx.xx/xx. Wireguard interface address, only required if VPN_TYPE=wireguard. Note this is usually specific by user and the same for all servers.

variables.name: WIREGUARD_ALLOWED_IPS
variables.description: OPTIONAL: CSV of IP address ranges, only required if VPN_TYPE=wireguard. Note this is usually specific by user and the same for all servers.

variables.name: WIREGUARD_MTU
variables.description: OPTIONAL: Any positive value up to 65535, only required if VPN_TYPE=wireguard.

variables.name: WIREGUARD_PERSISTENT_KEEPALIVE_INTERVAL
variables.description: OPTIONAL: Wireguard persistent keepalive interval. i.e. 25s.

variables.name: SERVER_COUNTRIES
variables.description: OPTIONAL: Comma separated list of VPN countries. https://github.com/qdm12/gluetun-wiki

variables.name: SERVER_CITIES
variables.description: OPTIONAL: Comma separated list of VPN cities. https://github.com/qdm12/gluetun-wiki

variables.name: SERVER_NAMES
variables.description: OPTIONAL: (PIA ONLY) Single server hostname. https://github.com/qdm12/gluetun-wiki

variables.name: SERVER_HOSTNAMES
variables.description: OPTIONAL: Comma separated list of server hostnames. https://github.com/qdm12/gluetun-wiki

variables.name: VPN_PORT_FORWARDING
variables.description: OPTIONAL: Enable custom port forwarding code for supported providers. https://github.com/qdm12/gluetun-wiki

variables.name: VPN_PORT_FORWARDING_LISTENING_PORT
variables.description: OPTIONAL: Port redirection for the VPN server side port forwarded. https://github.com/qdm12/gluetun-wiki

variables.name: FIREWALL
variables.description: Turn on or off the container built-in firewall. You should turn off for debugging purposes only.

variables.name: FIREWALL_VPN_INPUT_PORTS
variables.description: OPTIONAL: Comma separated list of ports to allow from the VPN server side (useful for vyprvpn port forwarding)

variables.name: FIREWALL_INPUT_PORTS
variables.description: OPTIONAL: Comma separated list of ports to allow through the default interface. This seems needed for Unraid containers and Kubernetes sidecars.

variables.name: FIREWALL_OUTBOUND_SUBNETS
variables.description: OPTIONAL: You first need to set your LAN CIDR in FIREWALL_OUTBOUND_SUBNETS. For example with FIREWALL_OUTBOUND_SUBNETS=192.168.1.0/24

variables.name: FIREWALL_DEBUG
variables.description: OPTIONAL: Prints every firewall related command. You should use it for debugging purposes only.

variables.name: LOG_LEVEL
variables.description: OPTIONAL: Container Variable: LOG_LEVEL

variables.name: DNS_SERVER
variables.description: (Recommended: on) Activate DNS over TLS (DOT) with Unbound

variables.name: DNS_UPSTREAM_RESOLVERS
variables.description: Comma delimited list of DNS over TLS providers

variables.name: DNS_BLOCK_IP_PREFIXES
variables.description: All private CIDRs ranges. Comma separated list of CIDRs or single IP addresses Unbound won't resolve to. Note that the default setting prevents DNS rebinding

variables.name: DNS_CACHING
variables.description: OPTIONAL: Unbound caching

variables.name: DNS_UPSTREAM_IPV6
variables.description: OPTIONAL: DNS IPv6 resolution

variables.name: BLOCK_MALICIOUS
variables.description: OPTIONAL: Block malicious hostnames and IPs with Unbound

variables.name: BLOCK_SURVEILLANCE
variables.description: OPTIONAL: Block surveillance hostnames and IPs with Unbound

variables.name: BLOCK_ADS
variables.description: OPTIONAL: Block ads hostnames and IPs with Unbound

variables.name: UNBLOCK
variables.description: OPTIONAL: Comma separated list of domain names to leave unblocked with Unbound. i.e. domain1.com,x.domain2.co.uk

variables.name: DNS_UPDATE_PERIOD
variables.description: OPTIONAL: Period to update block lists and cryptographic files and restart Unbound. Set to 0 to deactivate updates. i.e. 0, 30s, 5m, 24h

variables.name: DNS_ADDRESS
variables.description: OPTIONAL: IP address to use as DNS resolver if DOT is off

variables.name: DNS_KEEP_NAMESERVER
variables.description: OPTIONAL: Keep the nameservers in /etc/resolv.conf untouched, but disabled DNS blocking features

variables.name: HTTPPROXY
variables.description: OPTIONAL: Enable the internal HTTP proxy

variables.name: HTTPPROXY_LOG
variables.description: OPTIONAL: Logs every tunnel requests

variables.name: HTTPPROXY_USER
variables.description: OPTIONAL: Username to use to connect to the HTTP proxy

variables.name: HTTPPROXY_PASSWORD
variables.description: OPTIONAL: Password to use to connect to the HTTP proxy

variables.name: ENABLE_HTTPPROXY_STEALTH
variables.description: OPTIONAL: Stealth mode means HTTP proxy headers are not added to your requests

variables.name: SHADOWSOCKS
variables.description: OPTIONAL: Enable the internal Shadowsocks proxy

variables.name: SHADOWSOCKS_LOG
variables.description: OPTIONAL: Enable Shadowsocks logging

variables.name: SHADOWSOCKS_LISTENING_ADDRESS
variables.description: OPTIONAL: Port number for the HTTP proxy to listen on

variables.name: SHADOWSOCKS_PASSWORD
variables.description: OPTIONAL: Password to use to connect to Shadowsocks

variables.name: SHADOWSOCKS_CIPHER
variables.description: OPTIONAL: Cipher to use for Shadowsocks

variables.name: UPDATER_PERIOD
variables.description: OPTIONAL: Period to update all VPN servers information in memory and to /gluetun/servers.json. Set to 0 to disable. This does a burst of DNS over TLS requests, which may be blocked if you set BLOCK_MALICIOUS=on for example. Valid duration string such as 24h.

variables.name: PORT_FORWARD_ONLY
variables.description: OPTIONAL: Filter only port-forwarding enabled (aka *p2p*) servers (pia and protonvpn only)

variables.name: VPN_PORT_FORWARDING_STATUS_FILE
variables.description: OPTIONAL: File path to use for writing the forwarded port obtained. https://github.com/qdm12/gluetun-wiki

variables.name: VPN_PORT_FORWARDING_UP_COMMAND
variables.description: OPTIONAL: Command to run when port forwarding has finished setting up (pia and protonvpn only). https://github.com/qdm12/gluetun-wiki

variables.name: VPN_PORT_FORWARDING_DOWN_COMMAND
variables.description: OPTIONAL: Command to run when port forwarding has finished tearing down (pia and protonvpn only). https://github.com/qdm12/gluetun-wiki

variables.name: VPN_PORT_FORWARDING_PROVIDER
variables.description: OPTIONAL: Choose the custom port forwarding code to use. This is useful when using the custom provider with Wireguard. For PIA, make sure you set SERVER_NAMES=xxxx. https://github.com/qdm12/gluetun-wiki

variables.name: VPN_PORT_FORWARDING_USERNAME
variables.description: OPTIONAL: This is needed when using the custom provider with Wireguard with PIA. https://github.com/qdm12/gluetun-wiki

variables.name: VPN_PORT_FORWARDING_PASSWORD
variables.description: OPTIONAL: This is needed when using the custom provider with Wireguard with PIA. https://github.com/qdm12/gluetun-wiki

variables.name: HEALTH_SERVER_ADDRESS
variables.description: OPTIONAL: Internal Health Server Listening Addroess

variables.name: HEALTH_TARGET_ADDRESS
variables.description: OPTIONAL: Address used to check tunnel health

variables.name: PUBLICIP_FILE
variables.description: OPTIONAL: Filepath to store the public IP address assigned

variables.name: PUBLICIP_ENABLED
variables.description: OPTIONAL: Check for public IP address information on VPN connection.

variables.name: VERSION_INFORMATION
variables.description: OPTIONAL: Filepath to store the public IP address assigned

variables.name: HTTP_CONTROL_SERVER_LOG
variables.description: OPTIONAL: Enable logging of HTTP requests

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: Container Variable: PUID

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Container Variable: PGID
